409.description: Business conflict, including PURCHASE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED (retryable=false; no Retry-After), OFFER_CHANGED or idempotency conflict.

200.description: Replay of an accepted order already terminal

post.description: Eligible sale analytics require an authenticated SHOPPER, schema/header-valid request and known matching sale/product. Inventory enforces cumulative unexpired held + confirmed units per shopper/sale. PURCHASE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED is a stable 409 business rejection with no reservation or payment; replay the same key, use a new key for a later logical purchase after allowance is freed.

per_shopper_unit_cap.description: Cumulative unexpired held plus confirmed units allowed per shopper in this sale; frozen at sale start.
